def execute():
    n = int(input())
    print(compute(n))

def compute(n):
    size = int(4e5)
    upper = [0] * size
    lower = [0] * size
    for i in range(1, size):
        lower[i] = i
        upper[i] = n // i

    prime_flags = [True] * size
    prime_flags[0] = False
    prime_flags[1] = False

    primes = []
    for i in range(2, size):
        if not prime_flags[i]:
            continue
        primes.append(i)
        for j in range(i * 2, size, i):
            prime_flags[j] = False

    for index, p in enumerate(primes):
        for i in range(1, size):
            if n // i < p * p:
                break
            val = p * i
            if val < size:
                upper[i] -= (upper[val] - (index + 1))
            else:
                lower_idx = n // i // p
                lower[lower_idx] -= (lower[lower_idx] - (index + 1))
        for i in range(size - 1, p * p - 1, -1):
            lower[i] -= lower[i // p] - (index + 1)

    answer = 0
    for p in primes:
        if p * p > n:
            break
        if p * p * p <= n and p * p * p > 0:
            answer += 1
        if n // p > p:
            if p < size:
                answer += upper[p] - lower[p]
            else:
                answer += lower[n // p] - lower[p]
    return answer
